Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestInternationalFixedChronology_test_chronology_dateYearDay_badDate.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestInternationalFixedChronology/TestInternationalFixedChronology_test_chronology_dateYearDay_badDate.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original file is dominated by ~80 lines of unused `data_*` provider methods and dozens of imports that the single actual test never touches. The only behaviour is one `assertThrows` on `dateYearDay`. I'll strip all the dead code and keep the test identical.Compiles cleanly. I removed ~80 lines of unused `data_*` provider methods and the ~45 unused imports they pulled in, leaving only the single `assertThrows` test — now with a descriptive comment and named variables clarifying *why* `dateYearDay(2001, 366)` is expected to throw. The runtime behaviour is unchanged.
